answer: Prayers & Duties >> Death & Funeral Question ID: 7795 Country: United Kingdom Title: In mention of (Fatwa ID:380) the respected mufti said: "'It is prohibited to pray Janazah prayer in mosque premises, it is not right. The Janazah prayer should be performed outside mosque'" then why is it that janazah prayer is prayed inside the haram of the two holy mosques of makkah and madinah. Question: assalamualaykum In mention of (Fatwa ID:380) the respected mufti said: "'It is prohibited to pray Janazah prayer in mosque premises, it is not right. The Janazah prayer should be performed outside mosque'" then why is it that janazah prayer is prayed inside the haram of the two holy mosques of makkah and madinah. jazakkalah Answer ID: 7795 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1257/1147=L/1429) According to Hanafi Fiqh, funeral prayer is undesirable in a mosque, but other Imams allow it. The Hanafi Fiqh present the Hadith as proof: من صلى على جنازة فى المسجد فلا شئ له (ابو داود) It means that the person who will offer funeral prayer in a mosque, there is nothing for him i.e. he will get no reward. Also, at the time of the Prophet ( صلى الله عليه وسلم ), funeral prayer was being performed out of mosques. Ibn Habib says that in Madinah, the place for offering funeral prayer was eastward adjacent to the Masjid Nnabvi. (Fat-hul Bari ). And it is mentioned in Muatta Imam Muhammad: وموضع الجنازة بالمدينة خارج المسجد وهو الموضع الذي كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يصلى على الجنازة فيه The place to perform funeral prayer in Madinah is out of mosque, and this was the place where the Prophet ( صلى الله عليه وسلم ) offered funeral prayers (Muatta Imam Muhammad ). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
